displayName: Bow_W1 (raised, end wall aft -- Astra modular-width-raised-v1)
description: Raised section (upper deck Z 4.20) closed by an END WALL on its aft face (bulkhead 1.76-4.20, guard rail, door; twin stairs recessed in the two outboard corners unless noted), for a LOW neighbour on that side. docs/RAISED-SECTIONS.md sec 2-4. Wall faces use join standard W1x, connected faces W1xR.

sockets.notes: UNCHANGED from hull.bow.w1r2.v3 (README: 'carved prow remains unchanged', inserts taper toward 'the single approved stem'). Not independently re-measured from the FBX (see hull.stern.w1x.v1's boundsNote on the per-part axis-metadata issue found during measurement); carried over from W1-r2's own hand-measured value. Confirmed indirectly: the assembled-midpoint chimney cross-check (hull.stern.w1x.v1's Chimney socket notes) only reproduces the kit's own fittings.chimney_position if the bow's physics length is unchanged, which requires this stem X to be unchanged too.
Tip of the decorative prow; not a join. UNCHANGED (README: prow unchanged).

Y moved outboard from W1-r2's 3.45 by +1.4; see docs/EXPANDED-HULL-VALIDATION.md 'Gun slots'. Close to the aft join (full beam here; the taper starts further forward, same as W1-r2's own bow slots). NEW gun pair (spec sec 5): sockets/equipmentSlots already existed in the w1x source; added to capacity.gunSlots here. Provisional -- assembler check pending.

passages.notes: Upper passage over the raised deck, x 0.2-4.4 (stops short of the end-wall guard rail); |y| <= 2.30, so the stair corners (|y| 4.62-5.80) are not in it. Z centre 5.90, 3.4 tall.

hydrostatics.notes: export_hull_hydrostatics.export_module on the module-local Hull_Shell, deck_z 4.20 (tools/blender/modular_raised_sections_v1.py). Volume to 1.76: 227.6456 U^3 vs hull.bow.w1x.v1 227.7387 U^3 (0.041%, gate <= 0.5%). To 4.20: 413.9543 U^3 (stair notches and the door alcove are outside the shell, so already excluded).

holdCells.source: hull.bow.w1x.v1 6 + round(0.7 x 186.309 / 38.229) = +3; upper volume = own table V(4.20) - V(1.76), stairwells already outside the shell.

gunSlots.source: hull.bow.w1xr.v1 gun slots minus those whose clearance box hits a stairwell (dropped: none). Provisional.

capacity.rule: Seeded 2026-09-25 (RaisedDeckData): w1x module capacity + the raised deltas from docs/RAISED-DECK.md sec 5, using this module's own measured W1xR hydrostatic table and Blender deck footprint (not the sec-5 estimate numbers). PROVISIONAL, tune freely.

physical.notes: NOT AUTHORED. Must not be inferred from mesh size, section length or wheel radius.

upperStructure.source: Measured on the module-local Hull_Shell ABOVE Z 1.76 (faces clipped at 1.76, so the W1x topside band below it is not double counted -- unlike hull.*.w1xr.v1, whose wall area starts at Z 0.84): deck = flat top cap at 4.20 x 110 kg/m^2; walls = every other face above 1.76 (topsides, bulkheads, stair-notch walls, alcove) x 95 kg/m^2; stairs 60 kg per flight. centroidZU mass-weighted (stairs at 2.98). Provisional.

walls.notes: W1x face = END WALL (bulkhead + guard rail + door) toward a LOW neighbour.
